evaluations.rationale: The story only adds a music search/discovery capability and does not impose any permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule that conflicts with another story.
Adds profile-based music discovery; no incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule is created with any other story.
Adds discovery through similar users; no story imposes an incompatible rule or restriction on this capability.
Content-similarity search for music or ringback tones is additive and does not contradict another story's behavior or constraint.
Metadata and image-tag based discovery is compatible with other search and discovery stories; no conflicting rule is imposed.
Uploading tagged videos and making tags available is additive and does not conflict with any other story's permissions or constraints.
Viewing thumbnail sequences of video segments does not impose rules incompatible with any other story.
Getting info about similar video items and segments is an additive capability without conflicting constraints.
Perceptually similar video item information is complementary and not inconsistent with other stories.
Recommendations from similar profiles are additive and do not conflict with any other story's behavior or rule.
Recommendations based on relevant local news events are compatible with all other recommendation and discovery stories.
